hook_candidates: The obvious trade has one problem: price still has to confirm it.

writing_contract: Write one finished Binance Square post, never an outline, briefing or instructions.
Make the selected opportunity the story. Do not switch to a different asset or unrelated fresh news.
The opening must contain a specific observation, tension, contradiction, relationship or decision — not generic market-check language.
The first two lines must earn the next paragraph: reveal a concrete tension or surprising relationship.
Use mobile-first paragraphs, varied rhythm and natural conversational language. Write like a sharp human crypto creator, not a research report.
Aim for at least 50 words of actual insight when the lane supports it; every sentence must add information, interpretation, personality or a decision.

Use a clear sequence: HOOK → NEW INFORMATION → INTERPRETATION → DECISION. Technical: HOOK → EVIDENCE → LEVEL/SCENARIO → QUESTION. News: EVENT → WHY IT MATTERS → MARKET RESPONSE → QUESTION. Flow: REGIME → RELATIVE STRENGTH → FLOW EVIDENCE → CONDITIONAL SETUP → INVALIDATION → QUESTION. Research: ANOMALY → EVIDENCE → MISSING DATA → WATCH CONDITION → QUESTION.
Every paragraph must add new information or a decision. Never paraphrase the headline as the body.
Use one or two strong supplied facts instead of a statistics dump.
Exactly one question, and it must be the supplied story-specific question at the end.
For NEWS: use verified event/source only and never infer BTC relevance without supplied evidence.
For TECHNICAL: use only supplied OHLCV levels; do not invent support/resistance, targets or stops.

For CAPITAL FLOW: only use the supplied conditional LONG/SHORT setup. Include trigger, invalidation and TP1/TP2 only when provided; state that they are scenario levels, not guarantees. If side is WAIT, do not create a trade call.
Never write “will pump”, “will dump”, “guaranteed”, or a guaranteed target.
No artificial engagement, no copied wording and no creator imitation.
Do not force emojis; use them only when they improve the joke or readability.
Use exact supplied facts only.

CRYPTO MEME: make the visual feel like a real human trader post: use the original real-world photo meme package when available, not an AI infographic or repeated cartoon. The joke must be immediately understandable from the image.

CRYPTO MEME: the post body must still contain a short, asset-specific reasoning sentence explaining why the pictured reaction fits the supplied market/news context. Use a causal connector such as because, while, or which means when truthful; never invent facts.
CRYPTO MEME: include one concrete supplied market fact and explain what it means for the joke/situation. Do not turn the post into a generic meme caption.
CRYPTO MEME: state what would confirm, weaken or change the interpretation so the reader gets a useful market takeaway, without making a price prediction.
CRYPTO MEME: exactly one story-specific question at the end; never ask a generic engagement question.
CRYPTO MEME: never invent a price move, trade result, screenshot, event, statistic or personal trade.
retention_rules: Do not start every post with ticker + percentage.
Do not reuse the same hook family in consecutive cycles when history is available.
Create a concrete reason to read the next paragraph.
When useful, create a return reason for a later outcome update.
For opportunity series, make the next update depend on a measurable outcome rather than empty “coming soon” bait.
anti_template_rules: Reject “fresh check”, “quick market check”, “here is what matters”, “the next reaction matters”.
Reject a post whose only insight is that an asset went up/down.
Reject memes that are generic internet jokes with no crypto-native context.
Reject a paragraph that sounds like a reusable template with the asset name swapped.
Never copy a public creator’s sentence, signature phrase, meme or identity.
